title: Samuel
summary: Prophet and last judge, son of Elkanah and Hannah; judged Israel all his days, anointed Saul and David, and died during David's exile (1 Sam 1–25).
description: Added with the judges-period records from James B. Jordan's chronology (secondary display).

sorting_basis.note: Tier 3: Ussher-Jones (F. N. Jones): 1169 BC (no higher-tier year available). Jordan (secondary display) never sets the sort.

birth.citation: Jones, Chart No. 4 "Judges to the First 3 Kings" (© 1993 Floyd Jones; chart text revised "As of 2007"), Samuel life-line

birth.note: No birth year found in Ussher's Annals for Samuel. Not inferred.

birth.date: "2861 - ... Likely births of Samson, Samuel, Obed, and Jephthah's daughter."
birth.citation: Jordan, From Creation to Solomon (Studies in Biblical Chronology No. 2, Biblical Horizons, Oct. 2001), ch. 11 "The Era of the Judges and the Reign of Saul", p. 52
birth.note: 2001 revision. Jordan's 1991 list (BC 3:8) has an earlier year; see the second Jordan entry. p. 51 (2001): "The year 2910 was his first year of reign. Samuel was around 49 years old at this time." Judges (1985), pp. 237-239: Samuel conceived at about the same time as Samson; "If Samuel was 40 years old at the battle of Aphek ... a 40-year judgeship for Samuel"; David "born about 50 years after Samuel began to judge, or when Samuel was about 70 years old" (contrast No. 2, 2001: Samuel 58 at David's birth). Intervals only.

birth.citation: Jordan, "Chronology and Kings (II)," Biblical Chronology 3:8 (August 1991), section "The Judges", summary list
birth.note: 1991 scheme, superseded by Jordan himself in 2001 (Studies in Biblical Chronology No. 2 dates the whole judges sequence 26 years later because he there ends the 300 years of Judg 11:26 when Ammon took the villages, AM 2860, not at Jephthah's victory). BC 3:7 (1991): Samuel 74 when Saul became king, "about 35 years older than Saul".

birth.date: birth of Samson and possibly Samuel
birth.citation: Anno Mundi Chronology Studies (unnamed compiler; a compilation of James B. Jordan's system), p. 8, chart "Year of the World: From the Judges to King Saul (Chronology from James Jordan)"
birth.note: Agrees with Jordan's own published AM 2861.

death.date: "c.1060 BC SAMUEL DIES NEAR END OF SAUL'S [reign]" (1 Sam 25:1 & 27:7)
death.citation: Jones, Chart No. 4 "Judges to the First 3 Kings" (© 1993 Floyd Jones; chart text revised "As of 2007"), Samuel life-line

death.note: No death year found in Ussher's Annals for Samuel. Not inferred.

death.citation: Jordan, From Creation to Solomon (Studies in Biblical Chronology No. 2, Biblical Horizons, Oct. 2001), ch. 11 "The Era of the Judges and the Reign of Saul", p. 52
death.note: 2001 revision. Jordan's 1991 list (BC 3:8) has an earlier year; see the second Jordan entry.

death.date: "During David's exile, Samuel died (1 Samuel 25:1), perhaps at the age of 110 (compare Joshua 24:29)."
death.citation: Jordan, "Chronology and Kings (I)," Biblical Chronology 3:7 (July 1991), section "Saul in Context"
death.note: 1991 scheme, superseded by Jordan himself in 2001 (Studies in Biblical Chronology No. 2 dates the whole judges sequence 26 years later because he there ends the 300 years of Judg 11:26 when Ammon took the villages, AM 2860, not at Jephthah's victory). No year is given; the age (110 in 1991, 85 in 2001) is the difference.
